summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries and its Dutch finance subsidiaries filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $4.9 billion equivalent multi-tranche senior note offering: 1.0 billion euros 4.250% notes due 2033 and 500 million euros 4.625% notes due 2036 from Teva Finance II; $1.0 billion 5.500% notes due 2034 and $1.0 billion 5.750% notes due 2037 from Teva Finance III; and $1.2 billion 5.250% notes due 2032 from Teva Finance IV. Teva guarantees principal and interest unconditionally. Coupons, maturities and interest payment dates are fixed; optional make-whole redemption applies, with par calls from designated dates. This is a routine investment-grade-style debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing, demand and any use-of-proceeds disclosure for leverage or refinancing implications.
